title: Law to make anti-harassment building screening permanent
summary: This bill would make permanent the Certification of No Harassment pilot program, which requires certain distressed buildings to prove they have not harassed tenants before doing major construction work. It adds new criteria for including buildings on the program list, such as those sharing an owner with a building found to have harassed tenants, and requires HPD to republish the list every three years starting April 15, 2027. It also adds tenant notification requirements and an exception for routine cosmetic maintenance work.
